dataList.content:
I look up.
抬头望去。

There's the sun, shining from above us all. Just as it did on the day I killed Mother.
与我杀死妈妈那天别无二致，阳光高悬于顶端。

Something screams. It doesn't sound like anything I've heard before.
迄今为止从没听过的悲鸣传来。

I would compare it to the cry of a wounded animal if I were compelled to do so.
那简直像是野兽的咆哮。

It doesn't matter where I go—it's always there! It won't leave me. I'm never alone!
This voice, it—it—it won't look away from me!
无论在哪我都没办法独自一人！没法独自一人啊！这声音一直……在看我！在注视着我！！！

Ohh... how the sunlight prickles my skin... how horribly... warm...
啊啊……这刺痛我的阳光……温暖到令人恐惧……

I thought I could be alone in the darkness of my room... Just for one precious moment of solitude... Without anyone watching me... without pinning me with their gaze...!
我本以为哪怕只有一瞬……只有在黑暗的房间里……我才能独自一人……没有任何存在能关注我……！能将视线……！投向我……

Hnnh... I... Even now, I feel it...! The gaze... The sun...! The voice...!! It keeps following me!! Stalking me ever since those long, dark days... and the painfully bright nights came and went... It's here, even now... Closing in around me...!
唔呃……此刻……哪怕此刻也能感受到……！凝视着我……跟随着我的，这太阳！！声音！！从那漫长而漆黑的白昼……漫长而明亮的黑夜起，从那天起……啊啊……
It... understands me... It... AAAAHHHH!!! It's pinned me... with nails... and hammers...!!! 它在……理解我……它在……啊啊啊啊！！！用尖钉刺向我……用铁锤击打我……！！！

The gaze... the gaze boring into me... I... see now... It's you...! Don't look at me! Stop following me!!
视线……视线正穿透着我……？原来是这样……原来是这个人……别看我！！别跟着我！！

Mother bursts out of the room with enough force to knock the door off its hinges.
像是要把门拆散一样猛地推开门后，妈妈走了出来。

As her body writhes and spasms, something bursts out of her.
从妈妈窜动的身体里……有什么正迸发出来。
Meursault...! That gaze that watches me... it's... it's mine...! It's becoming mine, I'm being watched by my own gaze...! 默尔索……！我……我凝视着我自己。凝视起自己来了……！

I can't... I can't... Has it finally come for me, the final nothingness...? Oh, yes... I tried... I really, really tried my best...
啊啊……我要迎来终结了吗？是啊，我努力过了……我尽全力了……

I'm not even permitted... the briefest of moments to breathe... It's all over now... It was never going to—
只有这短暂片刻……是唯一能让我喘息的时刻……但已经做不到了。从来都没能做到……

I can't run... I can't breathe... I can't do anything, Meursault...!
逃也逃不掉，呼吸也做不到啊，默尔索……！

Mother...
妈妈……

No...! Meursault, my son!
不行……！默尔索……！求你了！！！

Before I hurt you, before I— Before I gouge out your eyes, you have to...
在我伤害你之前，在我……把你那两枚眼珠挖出来之前……

Oh, I'll end up killing my boy!!
再这么下去我真的会杀了你！！

Come, while compunction still strangles me... while the guilt of a failed mother who will kill her son holds me back... Oh, I never wanted this, this maternal love... Do it, kill me now! 在这份擅自产生的母爱……在这份无法保护好儿子的负罪感与愧疚将我束缚之前……快杀了我！！

You're right, I never chose any of this...! These feelings, they're, they're all just biology—chemical reactions in my brain instilling me with these emotions... just because I was born as this creature... a human...!
是啊。这份感情也不是我选择的感情……不过是因为我身为人类，作为人类出生了……身体……和大脑就擅自这样去想了！

AHHHH!! Stop, please stop... Those eyes are hammering their nails into me... I am... watching myself...! No, I don't want this... I don't want you to understand me...
啊啊啊啊！！停下，停下……那些眼睛正在钉住我！我在……看着我……！不要……不要理解我……

I just want to... breathe... I can't live anymore... I can't live like this... Knowing that someone is always watching me... Fixed by their gaze...
呼吸……让我呼吸……我已经无法再活下去了……但凡得知有谁正在凝视我，我就无法活下去了……

Meursault, dear... please let me nail the role of my son onto you for a moment...! If you're human... if you're something that came out of my womb, then kill me! 默尔索……我会……暂时把你钉在儿子这一职责上，原谅我……！至少，如果你是人，如果你是从我腹中生下的……！那就杀了我！

Kill me, Meursault... You're my son... It's the least you can do for your maman... Meursault...
作为儿子，你该做的是……杀死……妈妈啊……默尔索……

Though I did not hear anything that sounded like crying from Mother, I judged that she was.
虽然听不到哭声，但我判断妈妈正在哭泣。
... Is she? She is wailing and screaming, yes. But is that enough to be defined as crying? ……事实如此吗？虽然在惨叫，在呐喊……可即使如此，那真的能被定义为哭泣吗。

The ray of sunlight on my mother almost made it look as though she were laughing. From a different angle, she looks to be moments away from true liberation. Then...
被阳光笼罩的妈妈……看上去仿佛在微笑。又仿佛变得自由了。那么……

The stems of my thought beget stems that beget stems that are finer still. A lively bloom of compunction in my heart, creeping toward my judgmental, disobedient brain.
思绪翻涌不止。面对妄加判断的大脑，心中涌现起愧疚。

Mother takes a step toward me. Then another.
妈妈一步，又一步地向我走来。

Every step taken is a step removed from the form of hum—no. I mustn't define what is human. Mother is afraid of the gaze. I must not fix and nail my mother down. I mustn't judge... so I stop.
每接近一步，她都更加脱离人类的形态……不，不能将其定义为人类。妈妈恐惧视线。不该将妈妈钉住。不要判断……停止判断。
Stop thinking about it, Meursault—kill that thought! Just kill me!! 别考虑了，默尔索！杀了我！扼杀思考，杀了我！！

The same chains Mother and I used to regard slither from the ceiling.
挂在天花板上，那条我和母亲曾注视着的锁链掉了下来。

Despite the chains that have entangled her, Mother continues to take her steps toward me, through the pain.
尽管锁链缠住身体，妈妈依然忍耐着痛苦向前踏出脚步。

Her hands reach out to me, then enclose around my neck. They begin to strangle. A puff of exhalation, a reflex, ekes out of my throat.
妈妈的手伸向我。妈妈扼住了我的脖子。被压迫的气管中呼出轻微的气息。

No more judgments, okay? Just... act. It's the... only way to... save... yourself...
不作判断地……行动吧。那样，才能保护你……

I grab the chains that have fallen on Mother—and pull.
我扯紧了缠绕在妈妈身上的那条锁链。

The being not in the shape of Mother but the one I have defined as Mother thrashes violently.
虽然并不是妈妈的模样，但被我定义为妈妈的那个存在痛苦地挣扎着。

Mother thrashes violently.
妈妈痛苦地挣扎着。

I act to relieve my mother from her suffering. I act to kill my mother. As a son should.
作为儿子，为了不让母亲痛苦，我为杀死妈妈而做出了行动。

Ghk... Kergh...
咳……咳啊……

My fingers strain around the chains as I pull. I hear Mother groaning in pain.
我拼尽全力扯紧锁链。妈妈痛苦的呻吟声传来。

Mother not in the shape of Mother thrashes violently. She is trying to kill me.
与妈妈模样不同的妈妈，为了杀死我而挣扎。

Earlier, Mother in the shape of Mother screamed at me: "kill me." Did Mother truly wish to die, or did she—
与妈妈模样相同的妈妈，在叫喊着“杀了我”。妈妈希望的是自己的死吗，还是说……

I do not judge. I act as I'm told. I pull on the chains as far as their tensile force will allow me. I pull more. I pull beyond it.
我不作判断。只是依照听到的话语，将锁链扯紧，扯紧，再扯紧。
I sense a gaze. The same gaze Mother was afraid of. It is watching someone. It is watching me. 能感受到视线。妈妈恐惧的视线。那此刻也正凝视着谁。正凝视着我。

I am afraid. Mother who does not look like Mother cannot go to work tomorrow because her appearance does not align with the definition of what a human looks like. She cannot participate as a member of society. Then the being defined as Mother is gone, and a newborn something has taken her place.

我感到害怕。与妈妈模样不同的妈妈因为那副与人类这一定义相异的模样，明天无法去上班。无法参与社会生活。因此妈妈的存在已经消失，似乎有某种全新的东西从中诞生。

Then perhaps that being is not Mother after all.
如此一来，那存在或许并不是妈妈了。

The waves of remorse take hold of me. Of guilt. Compunction. The same emotions that were nailed into me at the birth of my existence, as Mother had said, surge uncontrollably.
然而，罪恶感与负罪感涌来。妈妈曾说的，那些自出生起便被钉下的感情正无可抑制地涌来。

Then perhaps that being is—
那么那存在……

I stop judging. I stop thinking. Until I am no longer a subject of anyone's attention, until silence comes—however long that takes—I pull the chain.
我停止判断。不再思考。直到任何事物都不在对我投以关注，直到寂静降临，而我对那需要多久一无所知，只是扯紧锁链。

The chain broke.
锁链断了。

Mother who does not look like Mother, Mother, the thing that was Mother, is motionless on the ground.
与妈妈模样不同的妈妈，妈妈，曾是妈妈的那东西，瘫倒在地，不再动弹。

Then... the curtains open.
随后……窗帘打开了。

Sunlight shines through, and the Voice—
唯有阳光洒落，而声音……

I shut my eyes, but the light penetrates the lids, filling my vision with hot red.
Whispers. Heat. Kindness. Nausea.
笼罩在我眼睑之上的灼热光芒。低语。热量。温和。晕眩。

Existence is unbearably discomforting. Freedom, terrifying. Definitions, arbitrary and fragile.
存在令人不悦。自由令人恐惧，意义则会轻易崩溃。

What, in this life, could be the proof of "me", then?
那么在这人生中，“我”要通过什么得以证明。

Memory? Experience?
记忆，还是经验呢。

Neither. What I thought, what I choose to accept...
二者都不是。我所思考，我所选择的是。

... is the now.
当下。
I feel... the moment. The now. 我感受着这一瞬间……感受着当下。

Defendant. State the time when you murdered your mother.
被告默尔索，你何时杀死了母亲？
dataList.place:
N Corp. Courthouse, Past
过去，N公司的法庭

dataList.content:
Before I realized it, I was brought before the court. When did Mother breathe last? I felt the warm slickness in my palms. Blood from the torn skin.
不知不觉间，我站上了法庭。妈妈是何时停止呼吸的呢。我的手掌被划破，流下的血液凝结起来。

I lost track of time. Mother lost track of time, too. Mother had stated her wish to die, clearly and desperately.
我无法感知时间，妈妈也一样。妈妈明确且切实地希望自己能停止呼吸。

But they ask persistently—when did Mother breathe last?
但他们却一直在好奇。妈妈的呼吸究竟是何时停止的。

The dead thing was defined as Mother, but it wasn't Mother. It was something else.
虽然死去的被定义为了妈妈，但那已经属于不再是妈妈的某种东西了。

My chains broke not long after Mother died. My chains broke long after Mother died. Or maybe Mother died before my chains broke.
我的锁链被扯断，或许是在妈妈死后没多久，又或许是许久以后，或许妈妈在那之前就已经早早地死去。

I killed Mother today. Or maybe it was yesterday.
今天，我杀了妈妈。不，或许是昨天。

They responded with unanimous outrage. They claimed that I did not understand the gravity of my actions and cited that as evidence of my ambiguous, dithering reply.
他们对我的回答感到愤怒。他们说我正是因为不清楚自己所作所为有多么严重，才会做出这样模棱两可又含糊不清的回答。

I said nothing in response. They were already hammering the nails into me at that point, and I had already made the decision to remain bound.
我没有回答。他们早已向我钉下尖钉，而我也已经决定任由他们束缚。

Defendant. State your reasons for committing the act.
被告默尔索，你为什么要杀死母亲？

I had no way of knowing. I would have liked for someone else to state that in my stead.
我不清楚。我反而更希望有人能告诉我。

I killed Mother? But I thought I killed something that was no longer Mother.
我杀死的是妈妈吗。我本以为我杀死的是不再属于妈妈的东西。

Mother was always afraid of the gaze. When she realized that there was no escaping the gaze, she instead desired death.
妈妈总是恐惧视线，深知无法从那视线下逃离，于是痛苦到想要死去。

The sunshine transformed Mother into a form that was no longer recognizable as human, and I wrapped the chain around Mother's throat and brought her to death.
那道阳光令妈妈不再具备人类的形态，而我扼紧了变成那样的妈妈的脖子，令她陷入了死亡这一状态。
Answer! 回答！

Shrill cries tore at the eardrums and mercilessly beat upon my ears.
仿佛要震破鼓膜的嘈杂声响毫不留情地轰击着双耳。

The collective gaze of the eyes from the second column on the left to the fifteenth column on the right bears down upon me.
从左侧第二排至右侧第十五排，集中投向我的眼球的视线。

From eighty-nine index fingers and eighty-six throats pour a deluge of grief, fear, hate, revilement.
八十九人的食指，八十六人的喉管中溢出的悲哀，恐惧，厌恶，谴责。

Questions shaped from various emotions slowly smother my breathing.
各种感情汇聚成的疑问，正逐渐扼住我的呼吸。

It's just that...
只是……

The sunlight... was overwhelming...
因为阳光……太过刺眼……

The sunlight was overwhelming, that's all.
阳光太过刺眼而已。

The courthouse is silent. The sunlight continues to whisper in my ears.
法庭归于沉默。阳光此刻也在向我低语。

Just as it did to Mother's.
就像对妈妈做的那样。

The sunlight spoke of warmth and blinding, prickling radiance...
那倾泻而下的阳光所诉说的话语……尽是些温暖却刺痛双眼的……

... and I trembled with fear, which brought with it a bout of migraine.
我因伴随头痛而来的恐惧而颤抖。

I gave up on trying to express these thoughts in words.
于是，我放弃去将那些思考以语言的方式表达出来。

They weren't actually curious about what I thought, anyway.
因为我清楚，他们所关注的并不是我的想法。

The court hereby sentences the defendant, Meursault, to...
宣告判决。被告默尔索……

I felt dizzy.
只是，感到晕眩。

I will dare to judge, act willingly, and if I am wrong, I will change. But I will move forward.
我会敢于做出判断，积极付出行动，如果有所差错，那就边纠正边向前。

I was afraid of speaking my mind, and following through, because there was no way to know what was right.
因为不知道怎样才是正确，我才害怕诉说自己想法并付诸行动。
A world without certainties is a world without answers, and cast upon this answerless world, I was just so afraid of the now that— 在这毫无确定可言的世界里找不到答案，这只是被抛入其中的当下，仅仅让人感到恐惧……

But I reach out with my hands anyway. Even if I am afraid.
然而，即使恐惧也要伸出手，迈步。

I reach out toward the sun.
向太阳伸出手。

Ma puce... they'll pin you with nails and leave you behind, just as they did at the courthouse.
小可爱……你最终还是会和在法庭上一样……被钉在原地的。

I don't care. That is within their freedoms.
没关系。那也是他们的自由。

But if I believe that they have misunderstood me...
但如果我认为他们误解了我……

I will speak again.
那我会再次诉说。

They'll misunderstand you again.
要是再被误解呢？

Then I'll speak again.
那便再诉说一次。

I'll gladly be wrong again and again, misspeak and be misunderstood countless times.
无论有多少差错，无论被误会多少次。

Even if the entire premise was wrong, even if everything is just a passing illusion...
即使前提只是虚构，即使一切都是假象。

Based on my sensations, I will judge. Based on my sensations, I will speak without hesitation.
我也凭感觉作出判断，毫不犹豫地诉说吧。

So that's your answer, ma puce.
这就是你的回答吗，小可爱。

So that's your answer, Meur.
这就是你的回答啊，默尔。

So...
所以……

The kind sunlight, with heart to spare for all of existence, the irresponsible sunshine...
温柔的，对一切存在都投以关注的，这不负责任的阳光啊……

This light that pursues me, it's...
这道始终跟随着我的光啊……

... noisy.
太吵了。

So...
所以……

Shut up.
闭嘴。
